title: A Generalized Matrix Inverse that is Consistent with Respect to Diagonal Transformations
summary: A new generalized matrix inverse is derived which is consistent with respect to arbitrary nonsingular diagonal transformations, e.g., it preserves units associated with variables under state space transformations, thus providing a general solution to a longstanding open problem relevant to a wide variety of applications in robotics, tracking, and control systems.
